channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jordan Poole | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jordan Poole from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Udonis Haslem, Jordan Poole
item.description:
“I remember when I got into it with Poole… I remember one person when the Jordan Poole incident happened with me who was really, really outspoken about it, and it really bothered me, was Udonis Haslem,”

Draymond Green on Udonis Haslem, Jordan Poole, Jul 12, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Willie Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Willie Green on #Pelicans making trade to add Jordan Poole, who's 26 and in seventh #NBA season:

“We believe we’re getting Jordan at just the right time, just the right opportunity in his career. He’s a guy who wants it. Works extremely hard, is in the gym night in and night out”

Willie Green on Jordan Poole, Sep 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Carlton Carrington on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Bub Carrington on Jordan Poole's impact as a mentor:

“That's crazy not seeing him in our locker room every day. J.P., that was one hell of a guy, not just a player... that was just a really good dude, like off the court. I was just at his house right before he got traded. We were watching the Finals together. He'd just invite rookies over. He invited my family over. It would be me, J.P. and like my cousins at his house. He is a really good guy, really good vet. Always very vocal. He taught me the vocal piece of being a leader.”

Carlton Carrington on Jordan Poole, Jul 8, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Steve Kerr, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
DeMarcus Cousins:

“I think they lost (Kuminga). I think Steve Kerr ruined that relationship with the DNPs. We've seen this happen time and time again when it comes to him and dealing with young talent. He just doesn't handle young talent well. He doesn't develop young talent. I mean, out of the years he's been there, we've seen one guy develop under Steve Kerr—and they ran him off as well—and that was Jordan Poole. So when it comes to young talent, I just don't think they handle it well. And I can see Kaminga being on the move.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Steve Kerr, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga, May 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Corey Kispert on Jordan Poole
item.description:
swingman Corey Kispert says.

“I think (Keefe) wants us to play a style that benefits Jordan: fast-paced and things like that. Also, he challenges Jordan all the time. He calls Jordan out all the time. He pushes him to be better all the time. So, that kind of accountability — when you come from a place that B.K. comes from — when you’re speaking to somebody, it pushes you to be a better player, and I’ve seen Jordan grow because of it.”

Corey Kispert on Jordan Poole, Feb 25, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Draymond Green on former teammate Jordan Poole:

“We played the Wizards last night, and I spent the whole game getting bullied. Bro, you was getting bullied. They got me on camera. I didn’t like that, but, you know, I went into that game just thinking I’m going to play a basketball game. Then dude came out there wanting to bully me. I don’t want no problem.”

Draymond Green on Jordan Poole, Nov 7, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“There’s a lot of examples of being angry at Draymond Green. The first one that jumps to mind is the Jordan Poole incident. Draymond and I are a lot alike in many ways. People probably wouldn’t see that from the outside, but we’re both kind of maniacal competitors, and we’ve lost our minds with each other during games—disagreements about strategy. But he crossed the line with Jordan, and he knows it. He knew it immediately, and it made that season incredibly difficult for everybody.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole, Sep 17, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma:

“What the front office has done really well is that now we look like a basketball team. The past couple of years, it’s been a little funky. But now, with modern basketball, we’ve got an electric guard in Jordan Poole. We have wings, whether it’s me, Bilal, or Coulibaly, and we have a big in Gafford who can really affect games defensively because he’s so long and his defensive instincts are amazing. So, we’re building a team right now, and in the next couple of years, with a good draft pick, we can be in a really good place.”

Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Poole, Sep 11, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I was so embarrassed to be around our team last year when Jordan Poole was still on the team. I came to everything. I was probably late last season 20 times, and I just paid a fine because I was so embarrassed to show my facein a time where it's like, before everything starts, that's when everybody is like shooting the [expletive] and having all the conversation. I was so embarrassed to show my face during those times that I would time everything up. If we're on the road, I'd time it up to the minute I need to get there, and if the elevator took a little bit longer than it was supposed to, I'd be late.”

Draymond Green on Jordan Poole, Jun 11, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
“I was so embarrassed to be around our team last year with [Jordan Poole] still on the [Warriors]… I was probably late last season 20 times.”

Draymond Green on Jordan Poole, Jun 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Jordan Poole
item.description:
“Jordan Poole, I love Jordan, and I know he has great, great seasons ahead of him,”

Klay Thompson on Jordan Poole, Mar 1, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole
item.description:
“I know that in my heart, that when (the punch) happened, we handled it the best way we thought we could handle it. But in hindsight — and hindsight is always 20/20 — we could have done better for sure. I just hate the way it ended for Jordan here, because he is a huge success story. For us and for him, this was a great marriage. He helped us win a title. We helped him, you know, become a champion and a guy who signed a big contract, life-changing contract. It was all wildly successful. But I hate the way it ended.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole, Dec 21, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Kuzma said Garnett is one of his favorite NBA players of all-time.

“It’s always great when all-time greats or just great players respect you. That’s amazing. For him to say that about me and not only me but Jordan as well. We’ve got a chance to do something, for real,”

Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Poole, Oct 14, 2023. Source: monumentalsportsnetwork.com.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Jordan Poole
item.description:
“I think it’s fair to say that there was some level of concern going forward, whether that was going to be something that would work out. To be honest with you, I think it would have worked out and could have worked out. ButI think it is fair to say that in order to make the team work next year, to make the numbers work and so on, someone probably was gonna be the odd man out. It just turned out – and it wasn’t planned – that it was Jordan.”

Joe Lacob on Jordan Poole, Sep 1, 2023. Source: Audacy.

item.title: Bilal Coulibaly on Jordan Poole
item.description:
“Jordan Poole sent me a text, 'Welcome to DC, can't wait to start working and playing with you.'”

Bilal Coulibaly on Jordan Poole, Jun 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Jordan Poole
item.description:
This postseason, his average is all the way down to 11.6 points per game on hard-to-watch 36/29/76 shooting splits.

“Watching Poole right now, I might trade him. … If I can package him and get someone I can rely on, I’m going to try it. He’s not Steph. He’s not a replacement. He’s showing me this s—t, that’s what he’s showing me,”

Gilbert Arenas on Jordan Poole, May 9, 2023. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Warriors coachSteve Kerr on Jordan Poole's deep missed three late:

“Jordan was wide open and pretty good look. That’s a shot he can hit. Really happy with that possession. Jordan had hit six threes already. That’s a great shot for us.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole, May 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Kerr on a pair of the team’s iron men:

“Loon and Jordan Poole are going to play in their 82nd games today. That's incredible. The durability, the availability each and every night.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole, Apr 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @KerithBurke.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Steve Kerr on getting on Jordan Poole for his technical foul:

“I snapped in that moment and he looked at me like I was nuts. ... I love Jordan and I love the way he's playing. He was incredible tonight.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole, Jan 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaltonJ_Johnson.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Thompson on Poole's late-game turnover:

“I told him there's a reason I threw him the ball ... he's a clutch player. He's a sharp creator and we wouldn't be on that win streak without him. We all go through those lapses early in your career.”

Klay Thompson on Jordan Poole, Jan 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
“It’s different now. And the reality is the first guy you come off the bench with is usually JP — and JP is a sixth starter. So that’s a different feel. … Whereas it used to be kind of a different offense, if you will, it’s more like the same. I think we have to figure that out in that second unit. What you’re accustomed to is Steph goes out the game and the whole offense changes, and it’s more sets. But with Jordan, it’s still going to be more of the same as you get with Steph.”

Draymond Green on Jordan Poole, Nov 14, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Kerith Burke:Kerr on the next place for Poole to grow:

“I'm gonna keep talking to him about his defense because I want him to play big minutes.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole, Oct 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @KerithBurke.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole
item.description:
“Draymond is playing next game, Jordan was playing last game. So I guess it's back to normal. Anything around our sport that doesn't just involve the game of basketball -- once it gets to that type of stuff, I try to stay away from it. It has nothing to do with anybody else but those people in the locker room.”

Kevin Durant on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole, Oct 13, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“Jordan's learning from the best ever in terms of playing on and off the ball.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole, Oct 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaltonJ_Johnson.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole:

“There’s a reason he’s in this position, about to sign a big extension hopefully. He’s tough. Mentally tough and physically tough.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Poole, Oct 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Draymond Green on how his apology was received:

“I think my apology was accepted pretty well from the team, at least that's what I was told. As far as how it was accepted from Jordan, I'm not sure how it was accepted.”

Draymond Green on Jordan Poole, Oct 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Mark Medina:Draymond Green:

“I was wrong for my actions that took place on Wednesday. For that, I have apologized to my team. I have apologized to Jordan.”

Draymond Green on Jordan Poole, Oct 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jordan Poole
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Jordan's feelings are most important. to be honest, I don't know how he really feels. That's not a bridge we really crossed yet, nor should it be a bridge we should cross yet.”

Draymond Green on Jordan Poole, Oct 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole
item.description:
“There's no reason to sucker punch the young fella. I told Draymond last night that he has to fix the situation with [Jordan] Poole... You never hit your teammates in practice, man.”

Stephen Jackson on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole, Oct 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Bob Myers on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole
item.description:
CJ Holmes:Bob Myers on how the Green / Poole situation was reported:

“I don't think this was related to who's getting paid and who isn't.”

Bob Myers on Draymond Green, Jordan Poole, Oct 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @CjHolmes22.
